profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at HMH
profile.summary:
IT professional with proven success in all facets of software development life cycle (SDLC) from analysis and design through development, implementation and integration as well as managing projects and teams in an Agile environment. Cultivate strong relationships by partnering with internal and external clients to solve business challenges through technology. 

SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE 
Languages:	C#, VB.NET, JavaScript, CSS, SQL 
RDBMS:	        MS SQL Server, Oracle, Sybase, IBM DB2, MS Access
Technologies:	ASP.NET, Web API, Web Services, XML, JSON, MVC, LINQ, ADO.NET, jQuery, SSIS, SSRS 
Tools:	        Azure, Visual Studio, SSMS, TFS, Fiddler, SpiraTeam, JIRA, ServiceNow, Scribe
Industries:	Field Service, Education, Pharmaceutical, Financial, Insurance, Aerospace

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed development and support for .NET web applications for Rights Management Tracking and Assessment Development.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: Manage all technical aspects of customized mobile field service software system implementations including application installation, technical configuration as well as integration design and deployment.  Collaborate with project managers, business consultants, developers, clients and vendors on new and upgrade installations of the Alliance Enterprise application.

positions.title: Lead Engineer / Solutions Architect
positions.description: Managed custom-built HMH Online Tracking System, an application developed in .NET / SQL Server and enhanced in an agile environment. Application provides intelligence around copyright obligations to ensure compliance with contract terms, expirations, and renewals.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Responsible for developing and maintaining systems designed to support the product creation and permission process for the Editorial Design and Image Services groups using Microsoft’s .NET technology.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for the design, development and implementation of the data interchange architecture for the company’s sales force automation (SFA) application deployed to 400 sales representatives.

positions.title: Lead Analyst / Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Lead Analyst	
Astra Merck Inc.:  Developed and enhanced a sales force automation/order management application used by 800 sales representatives.  

Senior Consultant 		
Clients included SEI Corporation, Reliance Insurance and FMC.
